verdict.rationale: GitHub ships two official CLIs: GitHub CLI (`gh`), which brings PRs, issues, Actions and auth (`gh auth login`, `gh repo clone`) to the terminal, and Copilot CLI, an agentic Copilot in the terminal installable via WinGet, Homebrew, npm or script that hands off sessions with Copilot in the cloud. Both are documented first-party and confirmed by the cli.github.com probe. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of either CLI in AI-native/agent workflows.
